welcome.title: Where do you want to work?
welcome.subtitle: LuDraw remembers your choice. To change it later, use the menu LuDraw → Change where you work.
local.title: On this computer
local.text: Boards are kept only here. Works without internet and without an account.
local.backup: Back up from time to time: nobody else has a copy of these boards.
local.separate: Boards on this computer don't show up in the browser or on the server. To move them, export and import.
server.title: On your organization's server
server.text: Boards live on the team's server, with live editing. You sign in with your account.
server.urlHint: It's the address you open in the browser to use your team's LuDraw.
server.ssoPlace: Company sign-in opens at {host}. Besides the server, only that address can open in this window.
server.plainHttp: This address uses http, without encryption. Prefer https outside your home or office network.
server.openFailed: Couldn't open the server. Try again.
server.saveFailed: Couldn't save your choice on this computer. Check disk space and permissions.
problem.invalidUrl.title: Invalid address
problem.invalidUrl.text: Type the full address, starting with http:// or https://.
problem.unknownHost.title: Address not found
problem.unknownHost.text: No computer with that name was found. Check the address and whether you are on the organization's network or VPN.
problem.offline.title: The server didn't answer
problem.offline.text: The server may be turned off, on another network or behind a block. Check your connection and VPN, or talk to whoever runs the server.
problem.certificate.title: This computer doesn't trust the server's certificate
problem.certificate.text: The server is up, but the secure connection couldn't be confirmed. This usually happens when the server uses its own certificate, which this computer doesn't know. Without that confirmation, someone on the network could pretend to be the server, so LuDraw doesn't open the address.
problem.certificate.user: Ask whoever runs the server to install the organization's certificate on this computer, then try again.
problem.certificate.admin: If you run the server: use a recognized certificate, or install your organization's root certificate among this computer's trusted ones. Also check that the address name matches the certificate and that it hasn't expired.
problem.notLuDraw.title: The address answered, but not as a LuDraw server
problem.notLuDraw.text: Check the address and the port. If they are right, the server may be older than this app: ask for it to be updated.
problem.incompatible.title: Different versions
problem.incompatible.text: The server and the app speak different versions. Update the app or ask for the server to be updated.
settings.text: This app is using the boards on this computer.
